recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: smartphone lenses folding into machine vision
flare bursts scattering over cold northern water
clear twelve-degree night over the bay
autumn dusk still an hour from sunset
side repos quiet while agents wait on the phone

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Sort falling glass lens shards and neural nodes into fused optics before an acquisition clock runs out — mismatched pieces shatter on contact.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: swipe left or right to slot each tumbling fragment
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each clean fusion completes one camera-to-AI conversion step in under a minute
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fragments tumble faster, decoy glass appears, fusion windows shrink
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: prismatic glass shards on matte black

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Rhythm-tap through flickering regional access gates — keep a data stream alive as permission lights blink in unpredictable patterns.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: tap when the green gate pulse aligns with the beat
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: sustain one unbroken connection streak for a full minute
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: gates multiply, off-beat decoys flash, tempo accelerates
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: amber server-room LEDs behind frosted glass

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Trace evacuation paths through autumn fog as distant flares burst over the water — reach the helipad before visibility collapses.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to carve corridors through brief clearings in the mist
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: each pier reached extracts one survivor before the fog wins
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: flares blind temporary zones, fog refills faster, false lights appear
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: cobalt night watercolor with orange flare blooms

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Hold and release to launch shortcut commands from a phone dock — spin up three micro-agents before sunrise crests the SF skyline.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: hold to charge, release to fire agent orbs at orbiting task nodes
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: three successful launches equals one feature shipped by dawn
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: nodes orbit erratically, charge window narrows, sunrise timer drains
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: pre-dawn gradient pixel skyline with glowing shortcut icons
